pricing.lede: A plan for your workspace, the price each builder sets for an employee you hire, and work credits for what your employees use. Your own employees have no employee price.
pricing.partPlanText: Seats, connected apps, approvals, limits and support. Every plan includes work credits.
pricing.partEmployeeText: Only for employees you hire from the marketplace. Set by the builder: monthly, annual or per task.
pricing.partCreditsText: What your employees use, at cost plus a small margin. Top up automatically within a cap you set.
pricing.employeesLede: Each employee on the marketplace has a price its builder sets. These come straight from the marketplace.
pricing.employeesUnavailable: Live employee prices are unavailable right now.
pricing.employeesUnavailableText: We couldn't reach the marketplace. Browse employees later, or join the beta and we'll send you current prices.
pricing.creditsLede: Credits pay for the work itself. Plans include a monthly allowance; most small teams never go past it.
pricing.creditsCapText: When your allowance runs out, credits top up automatically, never past the monthly cap you choose. At the cap, employees pause and ask you first.
pricing.creditsByokText: Connect your own AI model account and model use is billed by your provider, not by Fless. Other credits still apply.
pricing.calcLede: Pick a plan, add the employees you'd hire, and estimate how much work they'll do.
pricing.calcNote: Estimate in US dollars. Local price lists apply at checkout; taxes are added where required.

faq.a: Three things on one bill: your workspace plan, the price of any marketplace employee you hire (set by its builder), and work credits for what your employees use. Employees you build for your own business have no employee price.

faq.q: How do annual and per-task prices work?
faq.a: Plans and most employees can be paid monthly or yearly; yearly gets 2 months free. Some builders charge per completed task instead, for example per booked appointment. You see the price before you hire.

faq.q: Can I try an employee first?
faq.a: Many builders offer a 7-day trial. The employee profile says when one is available.
You set a monthly spending cap. Credits top up automatically only up to that cap; at the cap your employees pause and ask you first.

faq.q: Which currencies can I pay in?
faq.a: Pay in USD, GBP or EUR anywhere. In Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa you get local prices and pay in NGN, GHS, KES or ZAR. Cards and invoices worldwide through Stripe; local cards, bank transfer and mobile money in Africa through Paystack.
Yes. Cancel a plan or an employee at any time; it stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Credits already used are not refunded.
